text:
Mara K: Proposal: pilot an 'Action Ledger' for PM follow-ups. One lightweight record per incident capturing owner, due date, status, recurrence flag, postmortem link, and IC rotation note. 8-week pilot + weekly 15-min check-in. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Jordan L: Sounds good. Can we wire it to GH issues so owners, labels, and PR links work out of the box?

Samir: Agree GH issues are best. Draft ledger template: Incident ID, PM link, Owner @, Due YYYY-MM-DD, Priority, Status, Recurrence none/suspected/confirmed, 1-line RCA, Tasks, IC flag keep/rotate.

Khalid: I'll make a small dashboard for recurring incidents (heatmap + top 5 paths). Add label "recurring-pattern".

Rowan: For IC rotation: add a keep/rotate toggle and publish a monthly sign-up calendar in the handbook so knowledge is spread.

Elena: Comms cadence suggestion: T+0 post in #incidents + triage summary in #eng-oncall; T+1h update; T+24h summary with ledger link and owner/due table; T+72h remediation update; Weekly pulse until actions closed.

ops-bot: heads-up: Action Ledger template linked in #eng-oncall (https://go.redwood.example/action-ledger-template) :bell:

Mara K: Volunteers? Jordan to create repo + GH Action to auto-open issues and reminder pings; Samir to maintain template and pulse checklist; Khalid to build dashboard; Rowan to own IC calendar.

Mara K: Acceptance criteria for pilot start next Monday: owners assigned within 48h of postmortem, >=80% actions have due dates, weekly pulses scheduled. Any objections?

Jordan L: No objections, I'll start the repo today.

Samir: Good to go.

Khalid: :thumbsup:

Rowan: +1

Mara K: I'll post kickoff and the pilot runbook tomorrow. Ping me to join.
